findings: Actual desktop reference card has both original titles and correct personal credits; native controls remain below the source list.
390px inline reference list is very small at displayed video size; simulated 844px landscape Fullscreen API view is legible. This is not an inline-mobile fine-reading claim.
Desktop source panel, 390px dark source panel, and R2 mobile source panel show the original text/translation/editor explanation and source identity without horizontal clipping.

Conclusion and bibliography were separately captured at actual reading positions in both themes; the initial automated article-end screenshot showed later navigation/cards and was not treated as conclusion evidence.

Both mobile source panels have measured scrollHeight equal to clientHeight (495px) in these captures. They fit; no touch-scroll gesture executed in the supplement. Tap, close, source-link focus and Escape were exercised by the main report.
The initial poster capture can contain Chromium loading chrome after media data/poster decode. It is identified as an initial metadata/poster state, not a stable no-loading poster.
Opening the original Figure image navigates to a decoded 1920x1080 image; 390px fitted image is small. Physical phone zoom interactions were not tested.

failureAndFix.observed: Initial publication metadata omitted burnedInCaptions, making native captions default-on.
failureAndFix.fixScope: Root added meta.burnedInCaptions=true and rebuilt the site; media and frozen production inputs unchanged.
failureAndFix.retest: qa/site-local-caption-fix/report.json: 50 checks, 18 strict decoded-frame checks; pass true, inputsUnchanged true.

limitations: Simulated Chromium 1440x1000 desktop, 390x844 touch/mobile and 844x390 Fullscreen API; no physical phone/native-mobile video chrome claim.
No external-source destination navigation, word ASR, complete human semantic listening or audience comprehension measurement.
No movie-length real-time viewing claim; screenshot inspection and recorded actual interaction scopes only.
